title: Le Creuset Cast Iron Skillet No.16 – Brown – Made in France – Small Frying Pan
description:
Authentic Le Creuset cast iron skillet No. 16 in a classic brown exterior with black enamel interior. Made in France, this high-quality enameled cast iron pan is durable and excellent for everyday cooking.
Its compact size is perfect for frying eggs, small portions, sauces, or individual dishes, and it also works well for oven-to-table serving. A great addition for collectors or anyone who appreciates classic French cookware.
Details:
• Brand: Le Creuset
• Type: Cast iron skillet / frying pan
• Size: No. 16 (approx. 16 cm / 6.3 in diameter)
• Color: Brown exterior with black interior
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Made in France
Condition:
Good vintage condition with normal signs of use. The enamel interior remains in good usable condition.
A wonderful piece of iconic Le Creuset cookware, ideal for daily use or for collectors of vintage French kitchenware.
